title: Whisker Rattling
html:
Whisker Rattlings are small, unarmed Whiskers. They swipe ooponents with their sharp claws.

Race: Whisker

Class: Melee

[edit] Basic Types

  • Whisker Rattling. You will first encounter these in Dew Valley Forest.
  • Whisker Broodling. First found in the upper levels of Algernon.
  • Divine Whisker
  • Flame Brood
  • Vergrim's Brood

[edit] Uniques

  • Dew Valley Rattle Tooth is a Champion whose lair is located off level 3 of Dew Valley.
